name: infracore
description: Distributed microservices platform for managing shared organizational assets

scripts.dev: concurrently -n user,inventory,booking,notification,gateway -c blue,green,magenta,yellow,cyan "npm --prefix services/user-service run dev" "npm --prefix services/inventory-service run dev" "npm --prefix services/booking-service run dev" "npm --prefix services/notification-service run dev" "npm --prefix api-gateway run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix services/user-service install && npm --prefix services/inventory-service install && npm --prefix services/booking-service install && npm --prefix services/notification-service install && npm --prefix api-gateway install
